sentences.text: Phymolepis is an extinct genus of fish belonging to the order Antiarchi and the class Placodermi. It is a member of the family Yunnanolepididae.
The type species P. cuifengshanensis was named by Zhang Goroui in 1978. The holotype — the specimen the species is based on — was found in the Xitun Formation near Cuifengshan.
Several other specimens of varying completeness have been referred to Phymolepis, including some recovered from the Xishancun Formation.
Phymolepis lived in China during the Early Devonian, specifically between 419.62 and 413.02 million years ago during the Lochkovian stage.
